# 3D technical knowledge map

<!-- Generated by node tools/3d-knowledge.mjs render. Edit the JSON source, not this projection. -->

This is a curated lookup over existing public project sources. It does not replace product/asset/room contracts, private knowledge stores, or acceptance evidence. It does not contain confidential strategy or cloud/workstation originals.

## Use it before work

```sh
node tools/3d-knowledge.mjs search gaudi
node tools/3d-knowledge.mjs search sofa --kind recipe
node tools/3d-knowledge.mjs show lesson:metrology-boundary
node tools/3d-knowledge.mjs gaps
node tools/3d-knowledge.mjs duplicates
node tools/check-before-create.mjs asset sofa
```

The existing pre-create command includes relevant knowledge and source-location hits. Search is local and does not execute recipes or call providers. Open the pinned source and resolve the adoption gate before reuse.

## Snapshot and limits

Observed 2026-10-15: 129 curated records across 41 sources; 66 procedural recipe pointers; 112 model-path occurrences / 67 distinct Git blobs across five repository snapshots. These are different units. Recipe definitions and identical bytes do not establish accepted output, ownership or safe deletion.

- Default-branch model paths exclude procedural objects and branch-only or historical outputs.
- Source state and build/device results may differ; follow the pinned evidence scope.
- Private cloud originals, source checkpoint, complete account inventory and workstation metadata are intentionally excluded.

## Source and lifecycle policy

- `source-inspected` describes a cited source inspection, not an independent rebuild or physical-device test.
- `reported-in-source` preserves an existing observation or recommendation without promoting it to measured fact.
- `historical-observation` remains bound to the cited revision/run; it does not describe current main by default.
- `candidate` requires its adoption gate. `active-pointer` makes a lookup useful without promoting the referenced implementation.
- Add a scoped source, action and gate for every useful lesson. Preserve superseded records with replacement pointers; keep raw unfiltered reports outside default lookup.
- Render this guide after JSON edits; validation and the existing unit-test suite check drift, missing citations, unpinned sources and prohibited private data.

## Reusable lessons

| ID | Lesson and evidence scope | Apply / verify |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lesson:world-space-anchors` | [Validate mesh placement beyond pivots](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/konam/blob/29245e73f099b1f8a4ad27bbdb33d3216679a03f/blender/validate_asset.py) (source-inspected). A parent transform may be applied twice while object pivots still look correct. Check exported world-space geometry bounds and anchors. | When replacing or reparenting components, validate mesh centres against axle/BB anchors. **Gate:** Reproduce and test the serialized artifact; the existing bike check is not a universal mesh validator. |
| `lesson:metrology-boundary` | [Numerical consistency is not measurement accuracy](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/konam/blob/29245e73f099b1f8a4ad27bbdb33d3216679a03f/blender/validate_asset.py) (source-inspected). The 0.02 mm threshold is a consistency check against constructed bike targets. It does not establish real-world accuracy, hidden widths or manufacturing fitness. | State source uncertainty and independent measurement limits. **Gate:** Never convert a regression tolerance or silhouette overlap into a blanket accuracy claim. |
| `lesson:schema-evidence` | [Required fields do not prove evidence](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/konam/blob/29245e73f099b1f8a4ad27bbdb33d3216679a03f/museum/schemas/asset-manifest.schema.json) (source-inspected). The current asset schema has shallow provenance/LOD/performance objects; validated labels do not bind themselves to immutable artifacts or tests. | Inspect nested requirements and actual receipts before promotion. **Gate:** Extend the existing contract through reviewed migration; do not fork AssetSpec. |
| `lesson:scene-lineage` | [A room name does not identify its final authored variant](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/konam/blob/84cc91ef8acbc76bbc26bf246ae1706894fcdd6e/world/final-room-recovery-20261004.json) (reported-in-source). R1 recovery explicitly identifies different source generations and warns against copying a divergent runtime wholesale. | Resolve exact scene variant, required source/data/assets and visual baseline before wiring. **Gate:** Selective source recovery, visual parity and current runtime checks. |
| `lesson:ci-preflight` | [Infrastructure failure is not a measured runtime failure](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/konam/actions/runs/38528616074) (historical-observation). The inspected R1 journey job stopped because a referenced module was missing; migration replay stopped before RLS tests on missing config. | Validate workflow inputs before expensive setup; label blocked checks distinctly. **Gate:** Re-run the actual checks on the corrected branch. Historical R1 logs do not describe current main. |
| `lesson:sparse-errors` | [Do not invent root causes from aggregate telemetry](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/konam/blob/29245e73f099b1f8a4ad27bbdb33d3216679a03f/docs/AUDIT_REMEDIATION_2026-10-05.md) (reported-in-source). Historical public error counts lack stack traces; the remediation document explicitly declines individual retrospective root-cause assignment. | Record coarse impact and uncertainty; collect reproducible source-specific evidence. **Gate:** A causal record needs a reproducible case or direct log support. |
| `lesson:fallback-state` | [Rendered UI state can contradict a successful renderer](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/ai/blob/dbb81c7dc91b2a0d3932562ed1ccdb01af98a153/spatial-lab-demo/EVIDENCE.md) (reported-in-source). Spatial Lab evidence reports active WebGL plus a visible fallback caused by CSS overriding hidden state, with short-landscape action sizing issues. | Test actual visible fallback and controls on the named viewport/device. **Gate:** Current rendered-state evidence, not the existence of responsive CSS. |
| `lesson:thin-glass` | [Thin-glass shader recipe needs destination review](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/ai/blob/1d781704693bcfbcaa3c8c69b787421464748c7a/studio/shared/procedural-assets/LEARNINGS.md) (reported-in-source). Shared Cycles notes report transmission and shadow-ray treatment improved glazing; it is an artistic recipe with rendering assumptions. | Inspect the pinned recipe for cases/shopfronts; treat WebGL transfer as a hypothesis. **Gate:** Target-renderer visual review; do not use artistic shadow bypass as physical-lighting certification. |
| `lesson:wet-surface` | [Flatten wet normals before relying on a coat reflection](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/ai/blob/1d781704693bcfbcaa3c8c69b787421464748c7a/studio/shared/procedural-assets/LEARNINGS.md) (reported-in-source). The shared render notes report a wet mask, low coat roughness and reduced bump improved puddle reflections. | Prototype the existing recipe on one surface rather than reauthoring a whole material system. **Gate:** Compare target-renderer captures; preserve base material and frame budget. |
| `lesson:bounded-haze` | [Bounded atmosphere avoids an observed black volume failure](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/ai/blob/1d781704693bcfbcaa3c8c69b787421464748c7a/studio/shared/procedural-assets/LEARNINGS.md) (reported-in-source). The Gaudi notes report an unbounded world volume rendered black while a bounded haze cube was controllable. | Inspect volume bounds and density before increasing samples or rerendering unchanged input. **Gate:** A target-engine preview must support the proposed correction. |
| `lesson:object-pbr` | [World-scale object projection can help imported geometry](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/ai/blob/1d781704693bcfbcaa3c8c69b787421464748c7a/studio/shared/procedural-assets/LEARNINGS.md) (reported-in-source). Reported render improvements combined scanned PBR, real-scale box projection and procedural wear; imported UV behavior still needs review. | Reuse the documented material/provenance pipeline and inspect scale on imported context. **Gate:** Texture rights, source hashes, target renderer and no alteration of factual geometry claims. |

| `lesson:instance-variants` | [Share mesh variants instead of cloning every repeated prop](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/ai/blob/1d781704693bcfbcaa3c8c69b787421464748c7a/studio/shared/procedural-assets/README.md) (reported-in-source). The shared generator documentation uses linked variants and per-object material variation to preserve reuse. | Inspect shared mesh/material ownership before copying or applying destructive transforms. **Gate:** Measure scene cost and retain correct per-instance appearance/interaction. |
| `lesson:camera-evidence` | [A camera label is not proof of source-context promotion](https://github.com/joaoccaldas/ai/blob/2a97f314c9cd97aed1289120a2c17f2d1a8cda3e/projects/gaudi-nexus/config/current_world.json) (source-inspected). The Gaudi authority distinguishes live revision and municipal candidates; a selected camera alone does not reconcile source context. | Resolve source/context hashes, collections and CRS alongside camera identity. **Gate:** Explicit scene promotion plus reviewed context/evidence gates. |

## Unresolved gates

- **Editable source restore remains a separate gate:** Source export and checksum verification alone do not verify linked resources or a clean Blender/application restore.
- **R1 remains unmerged research:** Map current main implementation against the original drafts before changing AssetSpec, world routing or runtime code.
- **Physical-device acceptance is not implied:** Historical software/emulated/static checks do not certify a named phone or headset.
- **Intended use remains unreviewed for indexed source outputs:** A public locator, generated recipe, internal label or identical blob is not commercial distribution permission.

## Operating decisions

- **Reuse before creation:** The new map adds curated pointers and lessons to existing pre-create lookup. Product, room, storage and renderer authorities remain in their existing files.
- **Separate preservation from consolidation:** Capture irreplaceable source without waiting for a full taxonomy or deduplication project. Deduplication requires consumer, provenance and permission review.
- **Prove one class end to end:** A bounded asset-class loop limits adapter and validator scope; cross-class generalization is a later controlled experiment.
- **Do not defer safety until platform extraction:** Fresh-checkout correctness, allowed use, required release tests and source preservation remain prerequisites for the affected delivery.
- **Public technical projection only:** This curated map is not a replacement for private knowledge stores or a new asset/world schema. Confidential provider and workstation evidence stays outside the public repository.

## Update and validation

```sh
node tools/3d-knowledge.mjs validate
node tools/3d-knowledge.mjs render
node tools/3d-knowledge.mjs check
node --test web/test/3d-knowledge.test.mjs
```

Do not import confidential source files, provider download URLs, personal inventories or private filesystem paths. Preserve those through their existing private authority and keep only an authorized technical projection here.
